title: openai-responses: passthrough seed/determinism + metadata for compat and streaming stability
author: Marina Kovács
description: Add passthrough support for OpenAI Responses API flags (seed, deterministic) and surface metadata passthrough for compatibility with downstream SDKs and partner integrations. This change unifies the Responses compatibility layer across streaming and non-streaming paths, ensures seed/determinism values are preserved end-to-end for repeatable outputs, and forwards client-provided metadata through the gateway into request context and audit logs. Includes careful defaults to preserve existing behavior for clients that don't opt into these fields and a compatibility shim to map older openai-style parameters to Redwood internal options. Motivation: customers and SDKs expect the newer Responses API semantics (seed/determinism/metadata) for reproducibility and routing; without passthrough we saw divergence between hosted and dedicated/private deployments. This PR touches the gateway request parsing, the openai-compat adapter, streaming chunk envelope formatting, and audit/usage pipelines. The change set includes unit + integration tests, e2e smoke tests against the SDKs, and a documented rollout plan with feature flag gating across hosted and dedicated accounts.
commits: feat(openai-compat): accept seed and deterministic flags in /v1/responses adapter
chore(streaming): ensure metadata envelope persisted across stream reconnects
test: add unit tests for seed passthrough and deterministic mode
fix(audit): include provided metadata fields in audit log context
docs: update openai compatibility docs and SDK quickstarts
changes_summary: Routing: adapter now parses seed and deterministic flags and maps to internal options; Streaming: envelope preserves metadata across reconnects and includes seed header for in-flight deterministic streams; Audit: metadata forwarded to audit processor and stored in structured logs; Tests: added unit, integration and e2e tests; Docs: compatibility docs and SDK examples updated; Rollout: feature-flagged by account with gradual enablement and canary tests.
review_comments: Ayesha Patel (review): Please ensure deterministic mode is opt-in and that random seed defaults remain unchanged when not provided. Also request tests for reconnect semantics where a stream resumes mid-response.
Marina Kovács (author): Done, deterministic is opt-in and defaults are unchanged. Added reconnect test and clarified envelope behavior in comments.
Carlos Mendes (review): Nit: move the audit key mapping into a helper to make future extensions easier. Also ensure we redact any PII from metadata fields by default.
Marina Kovács (author): Extracted mapping into audit_metadata_mapper, added redaction step with configurable allowlist and unit tests covering PII redaction.
Evan Liu (review): CI flaky on the first run due to timing in streaming integration test, reran and it passed. Approving pending clean up of a TODO in adapter docs.
ci_checks: integration-tests: pass (flaky first run, rerun passed)
release_notes: Add OpenAI Responses compatibility: passthrough for seed and deterministic flags, metadata forwarding for audit/telemetry, streaming envelope stability improvements, and SDK docs updates. Feature-flagged rollout; no breaking changes by default.
rollout_plan: Feature-flagged rollout: enable for internal canary accounts, run 48h smoke tests, enable for 10% of hosted accounts, monitor error/latency and telemetry for 72h, then full rollout to hosted. Dedicated/private will remain opt-in via tenant flag and operator upgrade.
notes: Backported small fix to release/2025-01 branch to address an immediate compatibility issue with older SDKs; separate hotfix PR created for that backport. No customer-facing change required until feature flag enabled.
